name: Thaumaturgy (Neptune's Might) — Intermediate — Blood to Water

system.description: With a touch, you transmute a victim's blood into water by spending Mental Traits, each converting one Blood Trait. This is lethal to mortals within minutes and severely weakens vampires, inflicting wound penalties without actual injury; those with Basic Fortitude are unaffected by the penalties but still lose the Blood Traits. The water evaporates from a vampire's body at one Blood Trait per hour, but the lost blood does not return.
system.duration: Blood returns at one Trait per hour
